# `logical_net` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/logical_net.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

A logical bus network (doc 10 §2.7, rank 12, `project.jsonl`; FR-BUS-002): the scope of address uniqueness, with
its master and rate, which its ports read and never copy.

| File | `project.jsonl` |
| Rank | 12 |

| Record version | 1 |

## Types

### BusRate

A bus data rate in bit/s (FR-BUS-009: 9 600 to 12 000 000 for PROFIBUS DP), an integer like every number of
the format.

Type: integer (format `uint32`, min 0)

### Endpoint

One end of a connection, a definition or a bond (ADR-0007, doc 03 §9): a connection point of a function
or a junction. Encoding (doc 05 §3.2): `{"cp": [function, idx]}` or `{"junction": id}`.

```
use ew_schema::Endpoint;

let e: Endpoint = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"cp":["d40b6e93-25f7-5c1a-9e8d-7a3f1c05b6e2",0]}"#).unwrap();
assert!(matches!(e, Endpoint::Cp(_, 0)));
```

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: Connection point `idx` of a function; its ID `v5(function, idx)` is derived, never stored.

   Shape: object { `cp`: array of ([`Uuid`](#uuid), integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s)) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `cp` | array of ([`Uuid`](#uuid), integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s)) | yes |  |  |

2. **Form 2**: A junction.

   Shape: object { `junction`: [`Uuid`](#uuid) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `junction` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2). |

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### SourceRef

The import provenance of a record (doc 14 §2.3, ADR-0004 amendment 1): the lineage and the source key
from which the record's ID `v5(lineage namespace, key)` was derived.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |  | The source key, byte for byte (NFC), such as `qet:el:<uuid>`. |
| `lineage` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The import lineage. |

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`
